economic_hypothesis: A fresh causal 120-session low identifies a completed loss of prior price support. If at least one full free-float equivalent then changes hands without another coordinate break and price later closes through the ceiling frozen during the first ten sessions after that low, the base may represent a real ownership transfer rather than a cosmetic candle pattern. The pre-anchor 60-session high is a causal repair target and the anchor low is a causal failure coordinate.

v26_methodology_transfer.objective_pre_existing_object: fresh 120-session low plus the first-ten-session base ceiling
v26_methodology_transfer.capital_memory: authoritative PIT turnover_fraction summed only from completed sessions after the anchor and strictly before the signal
v26_methodology_transfer.natural_target: maximum corporate-action-coordinate high in the 60 completed sessions strictly before the anchor
v26_methodology_transfer.not_a_candle_pattern: The signal candle is only acceptance through a pre-existing ceiling after ownership transfer; it cannot define the anchor, base ceiling, or target.

novelty_boundary.different_from_true_gap: No gap or untraded price interval is required.
novelty_boundary.different_from_support_hold: The hypothesis is completed ownership transfer followed by resolution, not proximity to or holding of a rolling low.
novelty_boundary.different_from_former_leader_base: No former-leader runup is required; one full-float-equivalent turnover after a fresh causal low is mandatory, and the ceiling is anchored to the first ten sessions after that low.
novelty_boundary.different_from_quiet_inventory: The core state is high cumulative ownership transfer, not low recent turnover or a quiet platform.
novelty_boundary.different_from_chip_density: No reconstructed chip distribution, density, or CY-011 field is used.

development_window.reason_for_2015_start: 2014 is reserved as structural warmup after the 120-session anchor-history and 90-session post-anchor clocks; it is not a selectively removed outcome year.

causal_anchor.fresh_low: anchor coordinate low is strictly below every coordinate low in the preceding 120 completed symbol rows
causal_anchor.history_continuity: the 120th preceding row is exactly 120 market-calendar indices earlier and invalid_step_cum is unchanged
causal_anchor.anchor_validity: hard_valid, history_valid, current_valid, tradable, non-ST, market-rule valid, and nonblocking corporate-action state
causal_anchor.base_ceiling: maximum coordinate high from anchor offset 0 through offset 9 inclusive
causal_anchor.base_validity: all ten anchor/base rows exist at consecutive market-calendar indices, are valid/tradable/non-ST, and preserve the anchor coordinate lineage
causal_anchor.base_information_available: only after the close of anchor offset 9

ownership_transfer.measure: sum authoritative PIT turnover_fraction from anchor offset 1 through the completed session strictly before the signal
ownership_transfer.meaning: at least one free-float-equivalent has traded; this is a natural economic unit, not a fitted quantile

causal_opportunity.old_high: maximum coordinate high in the 60 completed sessions strictly before the anchor
causal_opportunity.rationale: Require both an economically material prior breakdown and enough frozen repair headroom to matter after costs.

first_resolution_trigger.decision_at: completed signal-session close after all registered daily and market-state fields are available

market_state_protocol.reason: BULL, BEAR, and TRANSITION candidates are retained for chart anatomy so a causal state distinction can be learned without deleting a market condition before seeing its full chart population.

frozen_chart_label.entry: first legal non-limit-up open in signal+1 through signal+3
frozen_chart_label.time_stop: first legal open after 40 held market sessions if target is not legally realized
frozen_chart_label.cost: 20 bps per side, 40 bps round trip
frozen_chart_label.corporate_action_contract: QD-010 exact coordinate lineage; fail closed on a blocking or unresolved change

chart_protocol.review_order: chronological first, with outcome/state contact sheets as secondary aids

prohibited: no market-state outcome aggregation before all charts are reviewed
no 2021-2024 signal or outcome read before the development gate
